children: Overview
U.S. community bank's Q3 net income rose 5% yr/yr, with EPS up to $0.51
Q3 net interest income increased year-over-year, supported by higher net interest margin
Credit provisions, net charge-offs and nonperforming loans increased from a year earlier
Outlook
Company says additional capital from subordinated debt will support future growth and expansion strategies
LCNB plans to focus on organic growth and expanding wealth management client relationships
Company remains focused on improving operating efficiency and leveraging its diversified revenue platform
Result Drivers
NET INTEREST INCOME - Co attributed growth to lower rates paid on liabilities, reduced liabilities, and higher yields on earning assets
NON-INTEREST INCOME - Declined due to lower service charges, fees, and loan sale gains, partially offset by higher fiduciary income
FIDUCIARY INCOME - Higher fiduciary income partly offset lower fee income, supported by new wealth-management relationships and higher managed-asset values
